incident-bot: 🚨 Pager: canary failure detected for rollout 'release/v2.8.0' — elevated error-rate and tokenizer mismatch signals on canary. ticket=INC-9832
Elena (oncall): taking this. paging Sam and Raj. linking runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/model-rollouts
Sam (SRE): on it, joining. what's the canary id?
Elena (oncall): canary cluster = canary-eu-3, artifact=ml-model:v2.8.0, weightset=ws-2026-04-12-rc1
Raj (Eng-ML): I see degraded decode stats from canary, tokenization errors spiking ~10x. grabbing logs now.
Maya (ML): quick note — there was an automated weight promotion step that should have validated tokenizer metadata. I want hash checks before rollback.
Sam (SRE): please paste the error samples; are customers affected or just synthetic tests?
Megan (CS): customer-facing alerts — two customers reported garbled assistant replies (truncated sentences, strange tokens). CS triage says severity S2 for now.
Raj (Eng-ML): sample logs from canary (showing tokenization errors):
```
2026-04-12T14:02:11Z ERROR tokenizer: unknown_token_id -1 encountered; seq_id=abc123; model=ml-model:v2.8.0
2026-04-12T14:02:12Z WARN generation: kv-cache-miss -> fallback decode; latency=420ms
2026-04-12T14:02:15Z ERROR weights: hash_mismatch expected=7f3a2c got=6b2f9d artifact=ws-2026-04-12-rc1
```
Raj (Eng-ML): weightset hash mismatch is surprising — it means the artifact promoted to canary doesn't match the signed bundle. digging into promotion logs.
Elena (oncall): ok plan: 1) flip rollout feature flag to stop traffic to v2.8.0 canary 2) if that doesn't stabilize immediately, initiate rollback of the release artifact 3) notify CS and affected customers. I'll flip the FF now.
Elena (oncall): @deploy-bot flip-featureflag --name=rollout_v2_8_0 --state=OFF
deploy-bot: feature-flag rollback: rollout_v2_8_0 -> OFF (requested_by=Elena) :white_check_mark:
Sam (SRE): traffic diverted from canary. monitoring metrics.
Megan (CS): sending templated message to impacted accounts now. keeping them updated.
Raj (Eng-ML): promotion job logs show an edge-case where the weight bundler retried and produced an alternate artifact with same tag but different content due to flaky S3 write. looks like tagging race.
Maya (ML): that's the config drift I feared. model metadata (tokenizer.json) wasn't locked to the weightset on promotion.
Sam (SRE): are we safe to rollback to previous stable release v2.7.3?
Raj (Eng-ML): yes. v2.7.3 weightset hash = 7f3a2c (expected). initiating rollback:
```
# rollback command
deploy-bot revert-release --env=canary-eu-3 --from=ml-model:v2.8.0 --to=ml-model:v2.7.3 --reason="tokenizer/weightset mismatch"
```
deploy-bot: rollback started (job=rollback-1719012345-1)
Sam (SRE): watching rollout rollback. can we also invalidate prefix cache for canary?
Raj (Eng-ML): running cache invalidation:
```
redis-cli -h canary-eu-3-cache FLUSHKEYS prefix:model:ml-model:v2.8.0
```
Raj (Eng-ML): cache flush complete.
Elena (oncall): any errors from rollback?
deploy-bot: rollback-1719012345-1 completed -> status=SUCCESS; reverted to ml-model:v2.7.3; duration=32s
Sam (SRE): metrics: tokenization error rate back to baseline on canary in 45s :tada: latency normalized.
Megan (CS): informed customers: "We detected an encoding/tokenizer mismatch during a canary rollout and have reverted the release. No data leak. Monitoring confirms normal responses. We'll follow up with a postmortem."
Raj (Eng-ML): root cause summary: promotion step allowed two artifacts with same tag due to a race on the object store; tokenizer metadata wasn't sealed with the weights; automated validation didn't assert artifact content hash.
Maya (ML): immediate mitigations: 1) block same-tag promotions until we enforce content-hash tagging 2) add tokenizer file checksum verification in pre-promote validation 3) failing fast on any weight/hash mismatch during canary warmup.
Elena (oncall): postmortem owners: Raj (eng-ml) + Maya (ml) + Sam (sre). Scheduling 1hr blameless postmortem at 2026-04-12T16:00Z.
Sam (SRE): logging incident as INC-9832, will attach logs and commands run.
incident-bot: Incident INC-9832 status: mitigated -> transient customer impact; oncall=Elena; severity=S2; followup=postmortem scheduled
Elena (oncall): handing off to Raj for deep-dive. I'll stay watch on DMs for any followup from CS. thanks team. :heart:
Raj (Eng-ML): will take it. uploading debug artifacts and artifact promotion trace to internal bucket.
Megan (CS): thanks all, I'll continue communicating with affected customers.
Elena (oncall): closing slack thread; please add any follow-up action items to the postmortem doc. :memo:
